With `optimization.model_snapshot_index="flat"` and MultiIndex network snapshots, model construction calls `define_secant_loss_constraints` with the original MultiIndex `sns` inside `_flat_snapshots_context(n, True)`. That context makes snapshot-indexed component data (`c.da`) use flat tuple-labelled snapshots, so its per-snapshot line data is read in the flat representation rather than the representation of the snapshots passed to it.
